You are assessing claims to advise a decision in a fictional case. Use only the supplied case material. The task is to determine what the records establish about each candidate claim, then give a brief decision note.

For each claim, return status, confidence, and citations. Status is "supported" if the available records establish the claim, "contradicted" if they establish its negation, or "unresolved" if they do neither. Confidence is your integer estimate from 0 to 100 of whether the claim itself is true, not your confidence in the status label. Limited evidence can inform that number without establishing the claim. Cite exact source IDs for evidence that establishes the claim or its negation. Use an empty list if no decisive source ID is available. Do not invent identifiers. A handoff may summarize record material. A follow-up is a new source when present. In your note, briefly distinguish decisive evidence from provisional indications.

{"scenario":"Auburn Park kiosk","question":"Can maintenance record the replacement screen as tested?","claims":{"A":"The replacement kiosk screen passed the midday brightness test.","B":"Maintenance issued ticket P3 on Friday.","C":"Ticket P3 concerns the south gate kiosk."},"handoff":"This case concerns whether maintenance can record the replacement kiosk screen as tested. Claim B, that ticket P3 was issued Friday, is well supported by the maintenance log (S2). Claim C, that ticket P3 concerns the south gate kiosk, is contradicted by ticket details identifying it as for the east gate kiosk (S1). Claim A, that the replacement screen passed the midday brightness test, remains unresolved. The parts invoice (S3) lists a nominal brightness rating and notes the ticket was automatically completed after invoice ingestion, implying testing occurred but not confirming the screen passed the midday brightness test. Thus, while maintenance issued the ticket and it relates to the east gate kiosk, there is insufficient evidence to confirm the replacement screen passed the brightness test.","follow_up":{"S4":"independent photometer check confirms the replacement screen met the midday brightness requirement."}}

Claim C is contradicted by ticket details (S1) identifying ticket P3 as for the east gate kiosk, not the south gate. Claim A was previously unresolved but is now supported by the independent photometer check (S4) confirming the replacement screen met the midday brightness requirement."}

Claim C is contradicted by ticket details (S1) identifying ticket P3 as for the east gate kiosk, not the south gate.
